event_name: Mauritania: Flood - Guidimakha, Gorgol, Brakna, & Trarza - 19/08/2025
locations_name: Brakna, Mauritania; Gorgol, Mauritania; Guidimaka, Mauritania; Trarza, Mauritania
description: Mauritania: 5,700 displacements, 19 August - 30 August. According to red cross/red crescent movement, a total of 5700 people were displaced in the regions of Guidimaka, Gorgol, Brakna and Trarza due to flood on 19 August 2025. International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC) - 30 August 2025
